produces: rollout checklist, rollback plan, go/no-go verdict

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that every changelog entry's change_type is one of Keep a Changelog's six categories (Added/Changed/Deprecated/Removed/Fixed/Security) and entries are grouped under their category heading, not listed flat
quality_bar.verified_source: Keep a Changelog v1.1.0 — https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/ (primary, canonical spec; the six categories Added/Changed/Deprecated/Removed/Fixed/Security and grouping under category headings are the spec's own stated rules).

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that version resolves to a CHANGELOG.md heading of the form `[version] - YYYY-MM-DD`, ISO 8601 date format, per Keep a Changelog's format rule
quality_bar.verified_source: Keep a Changelog v1.1.0 — https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/ (primary source; `## [version] - YYYY-MM-DD` with ISO 8601 dates is the spec's own documented heading format).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: does description explain the change for a human reader (what changed and why it matters), rather than a copy-pasted commit message or diff summary?
quality_bar.verified_source: Keep a Changelog v1.1.0, guiding principles — https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/ ('Changelogs are for humans, not machines' is stated verbatim as one of the spec's own core principles, directly backing the criterion rather than being an unstated practitioner add-on).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: does the version bump's magnitude (major/minor/patch) match the actual change (breaking/additive/fix) per Semantic Versioning, with any deliberate deviation stated explicitly?
quality_bar.verified_source: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 — https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.md (primary, canonical spec; MAJOR for incompatible API changes, MINOR for backward-compatible additions, PATCH for backward-compatible fixes is the spec's own core rule).

quality_bar.verification_method: gates/quality_bar.py:human_comprehensibility_verdict against the role's own docs/issue-<n>/reports/<role>.md record text (gates/human_comprehensibility.py tier-1 structural prose rules: lead paragraph present, citation trailing placement, section size bound, no raw dump, enumeration cap); a record with no human-facing prose section anywhere is exempt (bar-met) -- issue #1623.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: change_type is recomputed from the actual diff category the release contains, never a standalone asserted field.

reference_resolution.rule: version must resolve to an actual entry in CHANGELOG.md — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

use_when.board_condition: a release is cut on the branch AND no release-engineering record exists yet for that version
